data.title: Rosso Bay Residences
data.about:
Experience unparalleled luxury at Rosso Bay Residences on Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. This exclusive resort-style Aldar complex is located next to Nikki Beach Residences. The towers Rosso Bay Tower R1, Rosso Bay Tower R2, and Rosso Bay Tower R3 consist of two connected buildings each and are linked by a suspension bridge and a shared ground floor. There are 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, a limited number of exclusive sky terraces, and five-bedroom sky villas.

Developed in collaboration between Aldar and Nikki Beach, Rosso Bay Aldar properties are designed with meticulous attention to detail and provide a unique waterfront lifestyle. Residents can indulge in premium services, including Rosso B&B, 24/7 concierge, housekeeping, and pet sitting.

characteristics_module.title: The Project Offers Residents With Stylish and Comfortable Living Spaces
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Nestled on the picturesque Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, Rosso Bay Residences by Aldar provide direct beach access and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.
  • Residents can indulge in world-class Rosso Bay Residences amenities, including spacious balconies, swimming pools, a state-of-the-art gym, and a charming lobby café.
  • Each residence is meticulously designed to offer a sophisticated and comfortable living environment.
  • With a 5 per cent downpayment, owning a luxury apartment or penthouse at Rosso Bay Residences has never been more accessible.
  • Rosso Bay Residences location offers convenient access to major business hubs, cultural attractions, gourmet restaurants, high-end retail outlets, and wellness centers.

image.name: Rosso Bay Residences by Aldar in Marjan Island

location_tile.title: A Serene Community With a Rapidly Growing Property Market
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Living on Marjan Island offers a unique blend of tranquillity and modern luxury. Surrounded by the Arabian Gulf, the island boasts pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and a serene environment that provides a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. 

Residents can enjoy an array of recreational activities, from water sports and beachside relaxation to exploring scenic walking trails and parks. The island's natural beauty is complemented by world-class amenities, including gourmet restaurants, high-end retail outlets, and state-of-the-art wellness centers, ensuring that every need is catered to with elegance and convenience.

5 Minutes to InterContinental Mina Al Arab
7 Minutes to Al Naeem Mall
11 Minutes to RAK Mall
12 Minutes to RAK Hospital
25 Minutes to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport
30 Minutes to Dhayah Fort
